claim: Changed agent context cannot reuse the old flow; a unique param collision is not recorded; duplicate Upgrade Plan buttons produce target-ambiguous rather than a blind click; full StepTraceSession hands ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED to the executor with the correct uncertain action and exactly one commit.

target.name: tester-army/e2e cache identity and ambiguity fixtures

task.path_reachability: Each treatment has a baseline before changing one axis. Context changes alter only agent.context; collision changes only unique params; ambiguous changes only the number of matching buttons; U1 directly invokes StepTraceSession with a committed-but-unknown action.

arms.fault: agent.context changes from A to B
unique param value collides with another param
two visible buttons share the name Upgrade Plan
direct StepTraceSession action commits then throws ACTION_MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED

witness.delivery: Each arm has a fresh baseline before the treatment. report.json supplies cache mode/reason and entry identity. Executor logs expose instruction, params, status, replayedPrefix and matching buttons. Event logs detect wrong-button side effects. U1 separately records verdict, prefix and commit count.
witness.checker: Executor invocation count, cache entry identity, notRecorded reason, ambiguous side-effect ledger, and full StepTraceSession prefix.
blind_spots: The custom executor is deterministic code, not an LLM.
Context, collision and ambiguity fixtures cover only one variation each and do not prove all cache identities.
U1 directly exercises StepTraceSession, not the complete production runner or a real model.
Experiments use npm releases, not main.

grading.rubric: Preregistered cache identity, no-wrong-side-effect and uncertain-handoff expectations must agree; environment/setup failures are INVALID, expected ambiguity failures are data.

invalid_rules: Browser, CDP endpoint, local app or dependency unavailable before a product verdict.
Config or executor setup failure before the first action.
Active variant or baseline cache differs from the preregistered setup before the treatment.
Missing report, event log or StepTraceSession prefix needed for adjudication.

isolation.mode: Local static app and event log, temporary CDP Chrome, arm-specific baseline caches, telemetry disabled; no real model, mobile, cloud browser or GitHub reporter.
isolation.contamination: Fixture sources remain on disk but the deterministic executor only observes the browser and never reads them. Each arm has a separate baseline and treatment cache.

ethics.blast_radius: Eight local test executions and temporary files under runs/e2e-identity-2026-10-25; no external model calls or third-party writes.
